description: Suno Studio effect. Warm tilt EQ, tanh grit/drive, a presence bump, and a tone lowpass spanning clean fingerpicked acoustic through overdriven electric. Apply to the rendered GUITAR stem inside Suno Studio; this is not a lyric tag.

metadata.description: Suno Studio effect. Warm tilt EQ, tanh grit/drive, a presence bump, and a tone lowpass spanning clean fingerpicked acoustic through overdriven electric.

warmth tilt.description: Single tilt control: boosts lows near 300Hz and cuts highs near 4kHz (or the reverse when negative).
warmth tilt.label: Warmth

grit.description: Drive into the tanh saturation stage; low is clean, high is overdriven.
grit.label: Grit

presence.description: Peaking bump near 3kHz for bite and forward attack.
presence.label: Presence

tone.description: Lowpass corner that rolls off fizz for a darker or brighter tone.
tone.label: Tone

dry/wet mix.description: Blend between dry input and processed signal.
dry/wet mix.label: Mix

bypass.description: Pass the dry signal through unprocessed.
bypass.label: Bypass
